B1.name: Sessile / Spherical
B1.description: Resting, unpolarized, spherical cells with minimal displacement.

B2.name: Confined / Erratic
B2.description: Localized tumbling and searching within confined 3D microenvironments.

B3.name: Directional / Migratory
B3.description: Hyper-kinetic, elongated front-to-back polarity with rapid directional translocation.

B4.name: Flattened / Dynamic
B4.description: Dynamic deformation, oblate flattening, and crawling along surfaces.

B5.name: Adherent / Oscillatory
B5.description: Volumetric expansion (swelling), firm adhesion, high contact area, and localized membrane oscillation.
